The master asks slave 1 to "Write Multiple Coils": write 3 coils starting from 00001 (2 ON / 1 OFF)

── Data details ──
00001 = ON
00002 = OFF
00003 = ON

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 09  Length                  9 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
0F     Function code           0x0F = Write Multiple Coils
00 00  Start address           protocol address 0, PLC address 00001
00 03  Write quantity          write 3 coils
02     Byte count              2 bytes of write data
05 00  Write data              each bit is the state to write to one coil (LSB first within each byte)

── Notes ──
Writing 3 coils needs 1 data bytes, but the byte count says 2

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (15 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 9 (9 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x0F (Write Multiple Coils)
Start address: 0 (PLC 00001)
Write quantity: 3
Byte count: 2
Data: 05 00
PDU: 0F 00 00 00 03 02 05 00
